question:
Six numbers, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 and 12 are written on different faces of a dice. Three positions of this dice are shown here. Find the number on the face opposite 7.

solution: The logic followed here is :- From the given three different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below : As 7 is common on both the dices II and III, it is clear that 8, 12, 10, and 11 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 9 will be opposite to it.
